verdict.rationale: Kong provides a Konnect API (e.g., list-ai-gateways) and a kongctl CLI supporting both declarative-as-code and imperative one-off commands, implying broad control-plane parity with the UI, and AI Gateway entities (Models, Providers, Vaults, Auth Strategies) are documented as configurable this way. However, there's no explicit documentation stating full UI/API feature parity, and probes for a public OpenAPI spec all returned 404s, so completeness of API coverage can't be confirmed. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement or complete OpenAPI/API reference showing every UI action has an API/CLI equivalent, and independent confirmation of full CRUD coverage for all entities.
